summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI power-availability node found a narrow underfollowed lane around medium-voltage switchgear, electrical installation/backlog conversion, conduit/electrical raceway products, and HALEU nuclear-fuel availability. The strongest direct evidence in this pass is Powell Industries' disclosed data-center orders and backlog. IES Holdings and Atkore are plausible second-order beneficiaries through data-center electrical systems and electrical products, but require segment-level AI/data-center revenue verification. Centrus is a nuclear-fuel chokepoint candidate tied to advanced-reactor fuel availability rather than immediate data-center power delivery, so its AI relation remains more forward-looking.
